display_name: Generic CPU fallback (latency-only, no vendor profiler)
_note: Substrate-plane fallback for a backend with no complete native driver (workflow-language decoupling). Provides correctness + wall-clock latency ONLY; every vendor counter (dram_pct/sm_pct/occupancy) is honestly null. diagnose.py classifies the bottleneck as 'unknown' via its all-null short-circuit — no vendor thresholds are misapplied to non-vendor hardware. build.sh is heuristic-by-extension, honesty-gated: it maps a known source extension to a CPU toolchain only when that tool is on PATH, else requires an explicit --build-cmd, else exits code-3.
